message.text:
I need to identify which persistent entity types in the data layer are referenced by the most packages outside that layer. I will rank the top two.

The data layer is the `store` package. I will identify its persistent entity types and count external references per type.
I'll identify store entity types and count how many outside packages reference each one.

args.command:
echo "==== store type decls ===="
grep -h -E '^type [A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]+ struct' /bench/repo/store/*.go
echo "==== store packages / files ===="
ls /bench/repo/store/*.go

message.text:
Ten persistent entity types were identified in the data layer: Attachment, IdentityProvider, Inbox, InstanceSetting, Memo, MemoRelation, MemoShare, Reaction, User, and UserIdentity.

UserSetting was added to the persistent entity list. AuthenticationConfig was considered but excluded as configuration state. A Perl script will scan Go files outside the store package to count distinct external references per entity type. store/db is part of the data layer and will be excluded.

store/test is treated as part of the data layer. External references are counted across server/, cmd/, internal/, and other non-store directories. Each store.TYPE reference is grouped by its import package path.

message.text:
User is the top entity with 7 external package references, followed by Memo with 6. I am verifying whether FindUser, UpdateUser, and similar operations are being counted as separate entity references.

Word boundaries prevent partial matches like UserIdentity or UserSetting. IdentityProvider is zero because clients use the protobuf version. Test packages may be excluded.

Test packages are included as external references. Query DTOs such as FindMemo are correctly excluded. Package counts are measured per Go directory.

The data layer itself is excluded from external references. I am checking for additional *store.User pointers in cmd and internal/idp, and for type aliases that might hide entity usage.

args.command:
echo "==== store.User outside store ===="
grep -n --include='*.go' -r 'store\.User\b' /bench/repo --exclude-dir=store --exclude-dir=web --exclude-dir=proto --exclude-dir=.git | sed 's|:.*||' | xargs -n1 dirname | sort | uniq -c
echo "==== store.Memo outside store ===="
grep -n --include='*.go' -r 'store\.Memo\b' /bench/repo --exclude-dir=store --exclude-dir=web --exclude-dir=proto --exclude-dir=.git | sed 's|:.*||' | xargs -n1 dirname | sort | uniq -c
echo "==== store.Attachment ===="
grep -n --include='*.go' -r 'store\.Attachment\b' /bench/repo --exclude-dir=store --exclude-dir=web --exclude-dir=proto --exclude-dir=.git | sed 's|:.*||' | xargs -n1 dirname | sort | uniq -c
echo "==== any other store.Entity I missed? ===="
grep -n --include='*.go' -rh 'store\.[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*' /bench/repo --exclude-dir=store --exclude-dir=web --exclude-dir=proto --exclude-dir=.git | grep -oE 'store\.[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]+' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr
echo "==== cmd ===="
grep -n 'store\.' /bench/repo/cmd/memos/*.go
echo "==== server.go ===="
grep -n 'store\.' /bench/repo/server/*.go

message.text: User is the top entity, referenced by 7 packages outside the data layer. Memo ranks second with 6 such references. IdentityProvider, InstanceSetting, and UserSetting are excluded because they are only used through storepb or methods, not as direct store.Type identifiers.

h11.
1st: User (7 packages); 2nd: Memo (6 packages)

Persistent store entities (`store.User`, `store.Memo`, `store.Attachment`, …) were counted by distinct importing packages outside `store/` and `store/*`. `User` appears in `server/auth`, `server/notification`, `server/router/api/v1`, `server/router/api/v1/test`, `server/router/fileserver`, `server/router/frontend`, and `server/router/rss`. `Memo` appears in six of those (plus `server/runner/memopayload`, minus auth/fileserver). `Attachment` is third (4 packages).
